# Redbay Group

> Redbay Construction Ltd is an NCA Category 7 building contractor registered with the National Construction Authority of Kenya, based in Ruaraka, Nairobi. Redbay Group builds homes, schools, perimeter walls and interiors, and installs solar and wind power, across Kenya.

## Contact

- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 725 546 059
- Email: hello@redbaygroup.co.ke
- WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/254725546059
- Office: Ruaraka, Nairobi, Kenya
- Contact page: https://redbaygroup.co.ke/contact/

## Pricing

- Quotes are itemised bills of quantities with one fixed price, quoted before VAT.
- Perimeter walls: from KSh 14,000 per running metre for a wall 2.4 m high on a foundation 0.8 m deep, before VAT; gate priced separately.
- [Perimeter wall cost calculator](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/perimeter-wall-calculator/): instant estimate from the boundary length.

## Companies

- [Redbay Construction](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/construction/): Residential construction and development, delivering quality homes built for durability, functionality and modern living.
- [Redbay Schools](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/schools/): Developing functional, inspiring and adaptable educational infrastructure for schools and learning institutions.
- [Redbay Interiors](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/interiors/): Transforming spaces through thoughtful design, quality finishes and functional interior solutions.
- [Redbay Energy](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/energy/): Delivering solar and wind energy solutions for homes, institutions and developments.

- [Building contractor in Nairobi, Kiambu and Machakos](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/nairobi/): Ruaraka, Karen, Kamulu, Ruai, Kikuyu, Lukenya, Tala, Kangundo, Athi River, Syokimau, Juja, Ruiru
- [Building contractor in Diani, Ukunda and the Kenyan coast](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/coast/): Diani, Ukunda, Galu, Tiwi, Msambweni, Mombasa, Kilifi
- [School and home construction in Kajiado](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/kajiado/): Isinya, Kitengela, Kajiado town, Ongata Rongai, Kiserian
- [Building contractor in Nanyuki, Nyahururu and Laikipia](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/laikipia-nyandarua/): Nanyuki, Nyahururu, Oljororok, Ol Kalou, Timau
- [Building contractor in Kakamega and Western Kenya](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/kakamega/): Kakamega town, Lurambi, Shinyalu, Malava, Mumias, Butere

## Projects

- [Merishaw School, Isinya, Kajiado](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/merishaw-school/): Classroom blocks for Merishaw School in Isinya, built around a courtyard, from foundations to the concrete frame, steel roofing and finishes.
- [Maisonette, Baraka Estate, Nanyuki](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/nanyuki-baraka-home/): A family maisonette in Baraka Estate, Nanyuki, built from walling to the final coat of paint, with tiled floors and a cabro driveway.
- [Four-bedroom home, Lukenya, Machakos](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/lukenya-four-bedroom/): A modern four-bedroom home in Lukenya, built from the foundations up, with a stone-clad facade, balconies and steel windows.
- [Bungalow, Oljororok, Nyahururu](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/oljororok-bungalow/): Shell works for a bungalow in Oljororok, Nyahururu: slab, block walls, ring beam, timber roof and yellow stone cladding.
- [Two-storey home, Kamulu, Nairobi](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kamulu-roofing-shell/): Shell works and roofing for a two-storey family home in Kamulu, with a machine-cut stone ground floor, balconies and a red stone-coated tile roof.
- [Bungalow, Tala, Kangundo](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/tala-bungalow-shell/): Shell works for a family bungalow in Tala, Kangundo: stone foundation, block walls, ring beam, steel roof trusses and grey stone-coated tiles.
- [Maisonette, Diani, Kwale](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/diani-maisonette/): A five-bedroom coastal maisonette between Ukunda and Diani, with coral stone cladding, smoked glass balconies and timber pergolas on the roof.
- [Thatched gazebo, Diani, Kwale](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/diani-gazebo/): A traditional makuti-thatched gazebo in Diani on concrete columns and a raised coral stone base, with built-in wiring, low walls and a tiled floor.
- [Family bungalow, Kakamega](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kakamega-bungalow/): A family bungalow in Kakamega built from setting out to a finished hipped roof, with block walls, a front veranda, steel windows and a solar water heater.
- [SACCO head office, Nairobi](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/sacco-office-nairobi/): Office renovation for a SACCO head office in Nairobi: glass partitions, a boardroom, private offices, gypsum ceilings with LED lighting and a reception.
- [Home interiors, Nakuru](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/nakuru-interiors/): Interior finishes for a home in Nakuru: a fluted wood and marble-effect TV wall, tray ceiling, pendant lights and a fitted kitchen with granite tops.
- [Home interiors, Ukunda, Kwale](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/ukunda-interiors/): Interior finishes for an open-plan family home in Ukunda: a feature TV wall, tray ceilings with concealed lighting, and polished floor tiling throughout.
- [Two-storey family home, Kikuyu, Kiambu](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kikuyu-house/): Shell works for a two-storey family home in Kikuyu: concrete frame, walls, flat roof slabs, a stair tower and wide balconies with steel balustrades.
- [Perimeter wall, Nanyuki, Laikipia](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/nanyuki-perimeter-wall/): A complete perimeter wall in Nanyuki, from trench to finish: stone walling with concrete columns, plastered and painted, with coping and a steel gate.
- [Perimeter wall, Karen, Nairobi](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/karen-perimeter-wall/): A long boundary wall in Karen on reinforced concrete columns and a machine-cut stone foundation, built in block walling with columns cast in place.
- [Perimeter wall, Kikuyu, Kiambu](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kikuyu-perimeter-wall/): A machine-cut stone perimeter wall for a home in Kikuyu, built on trench foundations with a stone base, a damp-proof layer and concrete columns.

- [Building on black cotton soil in Kenya](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/building-on-black-cotton-soil/): Why black cotton soil cracks houses and walls, how to spot it on your plot, and the foundations that keep a building sound in Kajiado, Machakos and Nairobi.

- [Damp walls and waterproofing: causes and fixes](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/damp-and-waterproofing/): Why walls get damp, how to tell rising damp from leaks and condensation, and the waterproofing that stops it in new and existing Kenyan homes.

- [Rainwater harvesting for homes and schools](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/rainwater-harvesting-for-homes/): How to collect and store rainwater in Kenya: roofs, gutters, first-flush diverters, tank sizing and keeping stored water clean for homes and schools.

- [Net metering in Kenya: credit for your solar power](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/net-metering-kenya/): How net metering works in Kenya under the 2024 rules: who qualifies, the 4 kW and 10 kW home limits, how credits work, and how to apply to Kenya Power.
- [Small wind turbines for homes and schools in Kenya](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/small-wind-turbines-kenya/): When a small wind turbine makes sense in Kenya, how vertical-axis turbines differ, why site and height matter, and how wind pairs with solar.

## Frequently asked questions

### What do you build?

Family homes, from bungalows to maisonettes, school buildings, perimeter walls and outdoor structures such as gazebos. Redbay Interiors fits out homes and offices, and Redbay Energy installs solar and wind power.

### Where in Kenya do you work?

We are based in Ruaraka, Nairobi. We have built in Nairobi (including Karen and Kamulu), Kiambu (Kikuyu), Machakos (Lukenya and Tala), Kajiado (Isinya), Laikipia (Nanyuki), Nyandarua (Oljororok, Nyahururu), Nakuru, Kakamega and Kwale (Diani and Ukunda). Tell us where your site is and we will confirm.

### Are you a licensed contractor?

Yes. Redbay Construction Ltd is registered with the National Construction Authority (NCA) as a Category 7 contractor.

### Are your projects insured?

Yes. We hold Contractor’s All Risk insurance on our projects.

### How do you price a project?

We measure the work into an itemised bill of quantities, then give you one fixed quotation with the scope, timeline and payment stages written down. Prices are quoted before VAT.

### How much does a perimeter wall cost?

From KSh 14,000 per running metre for a wall 2.4 metres high on a foundation 0.8 metres deep, before VAT. The gate is priced separately. Our perimeter wall calculator gives an instant estimate, and we confirm the exact rate after seeing the site.

### What should I send to get a quote?

Your drawings if you have them, the site location, a few photos of the site, and when you would like to start. If you do not have drawings yet, tell us what you want to build and we will advise on next steps.

### Do you build from my architect’s drawings?

Yes. We build to the approved drawings and work with your architect and engineer during construction. If you are still choosing a design, our home designs page shows designs we have developed with clients.

### Can I build in phases?

Yes. Many clients build the foundation, walls and roof first and do the finishes later, as funds allow. We price each phase separately in the bill of quantities and plan the order of work so each stage is protected from the weather and nothing has to be broken out later.

### Can you do only part of a project?

Yes. As well as complete builds, we take on parts of a project: shell and roofing works only, finishes and interiors only, or a perimeter wall on its own.

### Do you renovate offices?

Yes. Redbay Interiors fits out offices with glass partitions, boardrooms, suspended ceilings and LED lighting, built-in cabinets and painting. We can work in the evenings and at weekends, so your office keeps running during the renovation.
